name: Shiva Skunk
summary: Shiva Skunk is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Sensi Seeds]] from [[northern-lights-5|Northern Lights #5]] and [[skunk-1|Skunk #1]]. Sensi says it was first released in 1987 under the plain name NL#5xSK#1 and was renamed soon after for the Hindu god Shiva. It is strongly indica-leaning and fast to flower.

sources.title: Shiva Skunk (regular seeds) product page
sources.note: Sensi says it was first released in 1987.

sources.title: 'Skunk Weed': A Beginner's Guide to Skunk
sources.note: Sensi lists this among the Skunk #1 hybrids it developed from genetics it received in the Netherlands in 1982.
